## 1. Overview

Under independent latent failure times the joint competing-risks
likelihood factorises into one Beta-Danish marginal per cause.

## 2. Simulated two-cause data

```{r}
library(BetaDanish)
set.seed(2026)
n <- 400
T1 <- rbetadanish(n, a = 1.2, b = 1.5, c = 1.0, k = 0.4)
T2 <- rbetadanish(n, a = 1.0, b = 2.0, c = 1.0, k = 0.2)
C  <- stats::rexp(n, 0.05)
time  <- pmin(T1, T2, C)
cause <- ifelse(time == C, 0L,
                ifelse(T1 <= T2, 1L, 2L))
table(cause)
```

## 3. Fitting the joint competing-risks model

```{r}
fit <- fit_bd_competing(time = time, cause = cause,
                        n_restarts = 5, seed = 1)
print(fit)
summary(fit)
```

## 4. Cause-specific cumulative incidence functions

```{r}
res <- cif_compare(fit, plot = TRUE)
```

## 5. Gray's test

```{r, eval = !is.null(res$gray_test)}
res$gray_test
```
